notes.title: First Update
notes.notes:
Our first update is here, and it’s packed with some cool new features and improvements for all drivers out there:



NEW FEATURES

🔹 2 new vehicles!

🔹 Dynamic Rain: A new random rain option that requires you to adapt to changing weather during gameplay.

🔹 Edit Profile: You can now change your username.

🔹 Traffic: Option to disable traffic in Endless mode.



IMPROVEMENTS

🔹 Brakes: We've improved the braking system to increase its effectiveness.

🔹 Rearview Mirror: Some interior rearview mirrors were malfunctioning and have been fixed.

🔹 minor bug fixes
